body:
Curated 10 FatBaby observations into EMILY/BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE.

Items:
- Founder real-time: (multi-seat Fibonacci pricing continued) unsure exactly where that doc lives — 'it's in some wiki somewhere if not in your context or in any of the layers of golden docs' — worth a search pass when that thread gets picked up (2026-08-20T03:54:25Z)
- Founder real-time: (PITVIPER/lobbies continued) human-only lobbies should exist as their own queue type; non-native bots showing up in them is treated as a licensing issue, same framing as the multi-seat Fibonacci pricing already planned in some DragonsNShit docs (2026-08-20T03:54:04Z)
- Founder real-time: (PITVIPER multiverse portal continued) the portal should let players queue up for different REDGARDEN lobby types specifically — OG Battlegrounds vs. the cutting-edge AI-squad-model-based lobbies (R&D deployment) (2026-08-20T03:53:21Z)
- Founder real-time: (PITVIPER continued) proposing PITVIPER as THE multiverse portal — a unified hub/launcher tying together the various game clients (SHANKPIT, REDGARDEN, GFD, BRAWLPIT etc.), not just a home for GFD's two clients specifically (2026-08-20T03:52:27Z)
- Founder real-time: (mod surface continued) new architectural idea — both GFD clients (lobby + battlegrounds_gui/FPS) might live under PITVIPER instead of staying separate; mentioned 'the osaka garage' in the same breath (unclear reference — possibly a themed hub/UI concept, logging verbatim rather than guessing) (2026-08-20T03:52:21Z)
- Founder real-time: (mod surface continued) especially prioritize the FPS 'edu edition' client (apps2/battlegrounds_gui) for the mod surface work (2026-08-20T03:52:13Z)
- Founder real-time: standing MO for GFD — all game expansions/features must be built as mod-API-first (mod surface exists, then the feature rides on it), not features built directly then a mod surface bolted on after (2026-08-20T03:51:37Z)
- Founder real-time: confirmed gpt2 model calls usually take ~4 minutes (matches the documented known-slow-cold-request issue), then said to skip the gpt2 diagnosis/wait for now (2026-08-20T03:49:43Z)
- Founder real-time: (CarePyre mesh network continued) the existing plan was partly written by Gemini Flash — good but may have downplayed nitty-gritty technical details; wants that research expanded and validated, not taken at face value (2026-08-20T03:46:57Z)
- Founder real-time: (CarePyre mesh network continued) key open question to validate — how do participants interact with traditional SMS/voice networks when they're off the mesh, e.g. 10 miles away from any node? Also: founder recalls watching mesh-network content that seemed 'very elaborate' (general context/interest signal, not a specific source) (2026-08-20T03:46:50Z)
